name: ember-initials
description: Advanced avatars generator for Ember applications. Initials Ⓜ, images 🌇, gravatars 👩🏻 and adorables 😍 All you need for your users profiles!

paragraphs: Ember Initials is a package for generating simple avatars using users initials, images, gravatars or adorables. It definitely supports Ember 3.16 (or higher). Thanks to highly customizable interface you can define defaults and even set fallbacks.
